name: Launch token with cross-chain metadata
description: Issue a token on chain A, store its metadata as a file on chain B (cheaper / cleaner medium), then cross-link the two so explorers thread the metadata to the issuance.

params.DESCRIPTION: MYTOKEN - see metadata FILE action on the secondary chain

actions.note: Pick the chain you want the canonical issuance on (e.g. Bitcoin).
Upload the metadata JSON on a cheaper chain (e.g. Dogecoin or Litecoin) - the data is hex / utf8 encoded.
Fill the COIN1/COIN2 tickers and action indices after rows 1 + 2 confirm. The cross-link threads them together in History.
